# koyeb_database (Resource)

Database resource in the Koyeb Terraform provider. A database is deployed as a service of type DATABASE inside an app named after the database; deleting the database deletes the service but leaves the app in place. Create and update wait for the database service to become HEALTHY or DEGRADED before completing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A database is deployed as a service of type DATABASE inside an app
# named after the database. Deleting the database deletes the service
# but leaves the app in place.
resource "koyeb_database" "my-database" {
  name          = "my-database"
  pg_version    = 16
  region        = "was"
  instance_type = "free"
  db_name       = "koyebdb"
  db_owner      = "koyeb-adm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The database name; an app with the same name is created if it does not exist

### Optional

- `db_name` (String) The name of the database created in the PostgreSQL instance
- `db_owner` (String) The role owning the database
- `instance_type` (String) The instance type of the database (free, small, medium or large)
- `pg_version` (Number) The PostgreSQL version
- `region` (String) The region where the database is deployed

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) The app ID the database service is assigned to
- `created_at` (String) The date and time of when the database was created
- `id` (String) The database service ID
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID owning the database
- `role_secret` (String) The name of the managed secret holding the database role password
- `status` (String) The status of the database service
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time of when the database was last updated
- `version` (String) The version of the database service
